sources.citation: TransNewGuinea.org language API (1081 languages listed) -- no entry for Nisa/Anasi (njs/bpo); East Geelvink Bay entries only Barapasi, Bauzi, Demisa, Keuw, Tunggare
Glottolog languoid record nisa1239 'Nisa-Anasi' (Geelvink Bay): Glottolog's most extensive description = wordlist or less; refs Briley & Briley 1991[1978] (1-page wordlist), Detiger 1935, Jones 1987.

Detiger 1935) finds Nisa [njs] be spoken at Anasi. The Anasi entry was.. based on the incomplete information -- just the name and location -- in Galis'. Glottolog's most extensive description = wordlist or less (Silzer & Heikkinen-Clouse 1991).
